statement: ∀ (f f' g g' : KdVPlan.Coeff), (∀ k, Summable (fun j => f j*g (k-j))) → (∀ k, Summable (fun j => f' j*g (k-j))) → (∀ k, Summable (fun j => f j*g' (k-j))) → KdVPlan.mul (f-f') g = KdVPlan.mul f g-KdVPlan.mul f' g ∧ KdVPlan.mul f (g-g') = KdVPlan.mul f g-KdVPlan.mul f g'
proof:
intro f f' g g' hfg hf'g hfg'
constructor

· funext k
  simp only [KdVPlan.mul, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub]
  exact (hfg k).tsum_sub (hfg' k)
